name: Jagananna Vidya Kanuka
benefit: In this scheme, the school students studying in Class 1st to Class 10th are provided with School Kits consisting of three (3) pairs of uniforms, a set of Notebooks, textbooks, a pair of shoes, and two (2) pairs of socks, a belt, and a School bag.
eligibility_rules: The applicant should be a resident/domicile of the state of Andhra Pradesh. The applicant should be a Student of Class 1st - Class 10th. The school in which the applicant is enrolled should be one of the following:
Government/MPP/Municipal/ Residential Schools of Education & Welfare Departments/ Ashram Schools/Aided Schools/ Model Schools/ KGBVs/ Registered Madarsas.
documents_required: School CertificateEducation Certificate (Marksheet / Passing Certificate of the Latest Educational
Qualification) Passport Size PhotoStudent Identity CardAadhar CardAadhar Card of ParentsIncome Certificate of the Parent(s)
how_to_apply: Mode: Offline The students need not apply to avail of the benefits of this scheme. The schools of Andhra Pradesh state will distribute the Jagananna Vidya Kanuka scheme kits to all school students at the time of admission.
